title: Inventory AST closure
rootCause: The conflict ledger closure verified receipt completeness against preparedInput.inventory, but did not independently establish that the inventory references themselves matched the raw AST input. A self-consistent forged inventory semantic key could therefore be trusted as its own authority.
changes: Added RequestTypeDerivationInventoryAstVerificationInterface to the upstream type contract.

Added requestTypeDerivationInventoryMatchesAst to independently compare route/resource/request inventory cardinality, occurrence identity, canonical semantic keys, source identities, and source spans against raw AST nodes.
Integrated AST inventory closure before accepting conflict ledger receipts.
Added regression test for a forged resource semantic key whose canonicalIdentity was forged consistently too.
structuralAudit: 121/121 assertions passed across phases 2665-2675 (10 audit scripts); Phase 2669 excluded because its audit is a historical patch audit and is not in this cumulative list.

runtimeStatus.vitest: not run until local dependency availability is confirmed
runtimeStatus.typescript: not run until local compiler availability is confirmed

scope: This phase strengthens AST-to-inventory correlation only. It does not claim full semantic proof, typecheck, Laravel scan/sync, or manifest equivalence.
